verses.1: And the word of Jehovah came to me, saying:
verses.2: The son of man turns your faces toward the children of his people, and then he rises above them.
verses.3: And you said to Benyamin, “Listen to what the Lord Jehovah has said.” This is what the Lord Jehovah said: “For you have spoken to My holy place, saying, ‘It shall be a river.’ And to the land of Israel, saying, ‘It shall be a resting place for people.’ And to the house of Judah, saying, ‘They shall go forth into the wilderness.’”
verses.4: Therefore, I will give you to the children of Adam as a heritage. Their towns will be in your possession. And we will give you those places where they once lived. They will eat your fruits, and they will drink your milk.
verses.5: And I will give them flocks of sheep to tend, and the children of Ammon to herd cattle. And know that I, Jehovah, am God.
verses.6: For thus said Adonai YHWH: “Your hands will be strengthened, and your feet will be able to walk. You will rejoice in all your endeavors, and you will enter into the land of Israel.”
verses.7: Therefore, I have laid my hand on you, and I will give you over to the nations. You will be known among the peoples, but you will be destroyed from among the lands. I will destroy you, and you will know that I am Jehovah.
verses.8: Thus said Adonai Yehovah: “For Moab and Seir, see here—all the nations are like this in the house of Yehudah.”
verses.9: Therefore, I will open the chest of Moab from its cities. From its borders, from the land of Beth Yishimot, from the house of Meon and Kiriya’mama.
verses.10: For the children of Kedem, upon the children of Amun. And it shall be given to Morasha, so that the children of Amun will not be remembered among the nations.
verses.11: And in摩押, I will make judgments, and they will know that I am Jehovah.
verses.12: So said Adonai Yehovah: Because Adam did these things, so shall they be punished. They will be punished for the sins they committed against the house of Yehuda. They will be avenged upon them.
verses.13: Therefore, thus said Adonai Yehovah: “I will lay my hand on Adam. I will recognize him from among all men and animals. And I will give him a downfall from the beginning, and he will be destroyed in his ruin.”
verses.14: And I will take my revenge on Adam through my people, the Israelites. They will do to Adam what I have done to him—with my own hands and with my own power. May they know my vengeance, O Lord Jehovah!
verses.15: Thus said Adonai Yehovah: Because the Philistines acted in their jealousy, they will be punished. They will be punished for their evil deeds, so that they may not continue to harm others forever.
verses.16: Therefore, thus said Adonai Yehovah: “I will lay my hand on Philistines. I will destroy their descendants, and I will make them a mere remnant left on the earth.”
verses.17: And I will carry out great vengeance upon them in their own homes. They shall know that I, the LORD, have taken my revenge upon them.
